title: Alekhine Defense: Exchange Variation
line: White trades pawns; Black takes back toward the center and later strikes with the other center pawn.

steps.text: In the Alekhine, White's pawn chases the knight and a second pawn joins it in the center.
Black hits the front pawn, a third pawn chases the knight again, and here White trades its front pawn for yours.
Take back with the pawn on c7. It keeps two pawns in the middle.

also.e7d6: That also works, and keeps the pawns even. This lesson takes back toward the center.

steps.text: Push the pawn on g7 one square, to make room for your bishop.
Put the bishop on g7. It aims at the pawn on d4.
Castle. Your king goes to safety, and a rook comes toward the center.
Strike at the center: push the pawn on e7 two squares.
steps.after: Your pawn hits d4 and takes a share of the center.

summary: In the Exchange, Black takes back toward the center, puts a bishop on the long diagonal and strikes at the center.
